description: This file defines the 'Api' controller class within the Opencart admin user namespace. It manages CRUD operations, listing, and history tracking for user API keys, including rendering views, handling AJAX requests, permission checks, and routing logic.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: Controller for managing user API keys, including listing, form handling, CRUD operations, and history within the Opencart admin area.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main API list page with breadcrumbs, header, footer, and API data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to get the list of APIs, outputs the API list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and prepares API data with pagination for view rendering.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the API creation/edit form with existing data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of API data, with validation, permission check, and JSON response.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected APIs, with permission validation, returning JSON status.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected APIs, with permission validation, returning JSON status.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected APIs, verifying permissions, returning JSON status.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays the API usage history view.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves and paginates API usage history records and returns the view.
